verdict.rationale: The only first-party natural-language-adjacent capability is a dedicated AI agent skill that lets a coding agent upgrade an existing CUDA-accelerated ROS 2 node for efficient memory transport. That is a single narrow task, not general natural-language operation of the simulator. The "agent-ready" label on Isaac Lab does not describe a natural-language command interface, and the evidence documents control mainly through Python scripts and ROS 2 services. Missing for 10: natural-language control of Isaac Sim or Isaac Lab (scenes, simulation runs, training), coverage of the agent skill beyond the one ROS node migration task, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
